origin.description: The urine data frame has 79 rows and 7 columns. 79 urine specimens were analyzed in an effort to determine if certain physical characteristics of the urine might be related to the formation of calcium oxalate crystals.
origin.details: This data frame contains the following columns: r: Indicator of the presence of calcium oxalate crystals. gravity: The specific gravity of the urine. ph: The pH reading of the urine. osmo: The osmolarity of the urine. Osmolarity is proportional to the concentration of molecules in solution. cond: The conductivity of the urine. Conductivity is proportional to the concentration of charged ions in solution. urea: The urea concentration in millimoles per litre. calc: The calcium concentration in millimoles per litre. Source: The data were obtained from Andrews, D.F. and Herzberg, A.M. (1985) Data: A Collection of Problems from Many Fields for the Student and Research Worker. Springer-Verlag. Davison, A.C. and Hinkley, D.V. (1997) Bootstrap Methods and Their Application. Cambridge University Press.
origin.value: A data frame with 79 rows and 7 columns: r, gravity, ph, osmo, cond, urea, calc.
